text: WJ Dreamlight 是面向 DSH Web 的外观主题插件，通过客户端主题服务注册节日壁纸主题，并在独立的“主题与壁纸”设置页提供预览和切换。它包含 VIP 金耀、端午、清明、七夕、元宵、中秋、万圣节和圣诞等内置主题，可调节侧边栏与对话区域透明度，也能创建、编辑和删除自定义壁纸主题。主题和设置保存在当前 profile 中，适合想个性化 DSH Web 外观的用户；无需 API Key 或外部账号。

WJ Dreamlight adds seasonal wallpaper themes to DSH Web. Users can preview and apply themes, adjust sidebar and conversation transparency, and create custom themes with a wallpaper and color palette. Preferences are saved to the current profile; no API key or external account is required.

WJ Dreamlight 的功能「壁纸主题切换」：在主题与壁纸设置页预览并应用内置节日壁纸主题，切换结果与主题偏好同步保存到 profile。
WJ Dreamlight 的功能「自定义壁纸主题」：从设置页填写名称、壁纸地址、强调色和明暗方案后保存；保存后主题会注册并出现在主题列表中，也可编辑或删除。

@tinyforge/dsh-theme README · Summary：WJ Dreamlight is an optional Web profile bundle with eight selectable themes, matching wallpapers, palettes, and previews — plus a generic theme interface so more themes, including ones you define yourself, reuse the same effect layer. VIP Golden Radiance adds gold accents, glass surfaces, a licensed display font, and light effects. The bundle and selected theme stay with the profile when DSH is upgraded.

@tinyforge/dsh-theme README · Use this package：Choose one installation method for the Web profile:

- **Official:** Open **Settings → Plugins → More → Official**, find **WJ Dreamlight**, then install and enable it.
- **npm registry:** Run `dsh plugin --profile desktop add @tinyforge/dsh-theme@1.1.0`.
- **From this Git repository:** Run `dsh plugin --profile desktop add git+https://github.com/phoenixlucky/dsh-theme.git#main`.
- **Local copy:** Run `dsh plugin --profile web add E:\home\dsh-theme`.

@tinyforge/dsh-theme README · Use this package：The current package id is `@tinyforge/dsh-theme` and its bundle version is `1.1.0`. The bundle supports DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`, `0.2.2-alpha.2`, and later stable `0.2.x` releases. Its `dsh-client-ui-theme` dependency accepts the matching compatible releases; that dependency version is not this bundle's install version. Install through `dsh plugin` so Harness records the bundle in the profile.

@tinyforge/dsh-theme README · Use this package：Open **Settings → Themes & wallpaper** — the gallery has a Settings page of its own, next to General — to browse the eight themes and adjust separate 0–100% background-transparency sliders for the sidebar and conversation area. Select a card to preview its wallpaper, then choose **Apply theme** to switch; the theme and transparency values are saved in the `dsh-theme` plugin configuration for the current profile and restored after restart on clients that load this Web plugin. At 0%, the original theme surfaces are preserved. Wallpaper visibility at higher values still depends on whether the host canvas is transparent. The gallery also follows the host theme settings for light, dark, and system, and saves whichever of the three you pick, so a restart keeps that palette instead of falling back to the system setting. Enabling the bundle preserves the current theme preference, including `system`; choose VIP Golden Radiance from the gallery to apply it. @tinyforge/dsh-theme README · Use this package：The browser plugin registers the eight themes through `ctx.theme` and adds its own `settings.section` page — wallpaper grid, surface-transparency sliders, and the custom-theme editor — instead of a row inside General. The page uses Harness configuration forms to save and restore theme and opacity settings in the profile. VIP styling is applied through a disposable stylesheet effect. Wallpaper images and the licensed display font ship with the bundle, so they need no network request or files from the application installation directory.

@tinyforge/dsh-theme README · Add your own theme：Every wallpaper theme is declared, not hand-styled. A theme supplies two effect inputs — an accent color and the light or dark surface it sits on — and the bundled stylesheet derives the glass panels, accent borders, hover and selected states, scrollbar tint, and the wallpaper atmosphere from them. Adding a theme therefore needs no CSS.

@tinyforge/dsh-theme README · Add your own theme：- **From the gallery:** open **Settings → Themes & wallpaper**, choose **Add custom theme**, and fill in a name, an image URL (`https://…`, `data:image/…`, or an app-relative `/…` path), an accent color, and whether it sits on the light or dark palette. Custom themes appear in the same grid with a **Custom** badge, can be edited or deleted from their preview, and are stored in the profile's `dsh-theme` configuration as `customThemes`.
- **From code:** append one entry to `builtInThemes` in `lib/client.js`, or call `ctx.theme.register(createWallpaperTheme({ … }))`. The spec is `id`, `accent`, `wallpaper`, `colorScheme`, and optional `surface`, `ink`, `overlay`, `labels`, and `extraTokens` for raw token overrides.

@tinyforge/dsh-theme README · Add your own theme：The effect layer reads `--dsh-theme-accent` and `--dsh-theme-surface` from the registered tokens and namespaces its own values as `--dsh-theme-*`, so a theme can override any derived token without touching the stylesheet. Motion duration, hover lift, glass fills, borders, and the wallpaper atmosphere stay separate tokens, and decorative motion is disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

@tinyforge/dsh-theme README · Supported versions：This bundle targets DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`, `0.2.2-alpha.2`, and later stable `0.2.x` releases whose `dsh-client-ui-theme` exports the external theme metadata fields. A DSH release outside those ranges needs a compatible bundle release.

@tinyforge/dsh-theme README · License：The wallpaper artwork is packaged under `assets/`. The GuruQiuWan display font and its Apache-2.0 notice are included there as well; see `font-license.txt` and `LICENSE-2.0.txt`.
